## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, what changes for the user, and any limits.

## Verification

Record the checks actually run. Include screenshots for visible changes and case results for changes to workflow behavior. Distinguish deterministic fixtures, recorded evidence and new provider calls.

## Review notes

Call out schema/rubric changes, data migrations, approval boundaries, cost behavior or attribution changes when relevant. Preserve unrelated workflow nodes and the evidence attached to earlier revisions.
